origin.description: Fraction of each cell covered by a polygon. Outside cells are 0 unless crop is true.
origin.details: Fraction of each cell covered by a polygon. Outside cells are 0 unless crop is true.
origin.value: A raster, a number, or a matrix of polygon indexes.
origin.example:
rast <- raster::raster(xmn=0, xmx=3, ymn=0, ymx=3, nrows=3, ncols=3, crs=NA)
square <- sf::st_sfc(sf::st_polygon(list(matrix(c(0.5,0.5, 2.5,0.5, 2.5,2.5, 0.5,2.5, 0.5,0.5), ncol=2, byrow=TRUE))))
writeLines(apply(as.matrix(coverage_fraction(rast, square)[[1]]), 1, function(row) paste(sprintf("%.17g", row), collapse=" ")))

translation.description: Fraction of each cell covered by a polygon. Outside cells are 0 unless crop is true.
translation.details: Fraction of each cell covered by a polygon. Outside cells are 0 unless crop is true. A grid is an extent and a resolution, with values when the cells hold data. A polygon is WKT. Row 0 is north.
translation.value: A dict with values and an extent, a list of those, or a list of numbers.
